entities.summary: Joshua Morrissey is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman and alternate captain for the Winnipeg Jets of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the Jets in the first round, 13th overall, of the 2013 NHL entry draft.
